create_xglm_config: create an XGLMConfig instance with default facebook/xglm-564M style configuration parameters
init_xglm_model_from_config: initialize an XGLMModel using an XGLMConfig configuration object
access_model_configuration: access the model configuration via model.config attribute
configure_xglm_attention_heads: configure XGLMConfig with custom number of attention heads and hidden size
configure_xglm_embedding_and_dropout: configure XGLMConfig with custom vocab size, max position embeddings, dropout, and activation settings
